system.description: This Charm builds upon its prerequisite. While Luminous Exhalation allows the raksha only to spend Essence in place of gossamer as ammunition for Ring- or Staff-shaping attacks, this Charm allows her to convert Essence directly into gossamer, which can be used for any purpose. One point of gossamer can be created from five motes of Essence, and the transubstantiation can be performed only in the Middlemarches or deeper into the Wyld. Gossamer created through this Charm is inherently unstable and dissolves into nothingness at the end of the tale.
